# Lightfield | Core QA User Guide

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Which organization is it best for? | In founders selling tech startups transitioning to formal GTM teams, as well as companies looking to read the customer context in its entirety. |
| What is the primary problem it solves? | Its primary value is the CRM, a natural language for high-growth founders and Ai Native, which automatically assembles its clients' “world model” from mail, calendar and conferences. For the procurement party, this location should be mapped to quantifiable issues, such as data integrity, follow-up timeliness, scheduling time or evaluation completion. |
| Is it possible to replace the existing core system? | Direct replacements can be assessed if demand is dominated by sales relationships, pipelines and communications, and if existing systems also contain CPQ, finance, services or complex primary data, they should be either complementary or phased. Credits uses are highly associated with external call intensity; it is Enterprise that provides SSO, RBAC and custom integration; the functional maturity of the new platform needs to be validated through real processes. |
| How should AI and automation be evaluated? | Don't just watch the demo. Verify with 20—50 real records or one full cycle: input source, recommendation accuracy, manual review points, permissions, failure rollbacks, dosage costs, and audit records. |
| How do you understand public pricing? | The latest official note uses credits: Starter uncommitted, $0.040/credit; Pro $10,000/year, approximately 330,000 credits; Growth, $24,000/year, approximately 850,000 credits; Enterprise request. The old help page still shows a seating programme such as Starter $89/user/month, and the contractual clients may be in a relocation period. The open price is only the software entrance, and taxes, minimum numbers, implementation, migration, integration, communications/AI usage and advanced support should enter the TCO for three years. |
| What should I pay attention to when using it in Hong Kong or across regions? | Need to confirm data residency, cross-border transmission, meeting recording consent, email marketing rules, currency and time zone. CRM claims that GDPR/SOC 2 does not automatically satisfy the Hong Kong PDPO. |
| What are the integration priorities? | Priority checks for authentication, mail/calendar or attendance devices, master data direction, API limits, webhooks, error retries, field mappings, historical backfill, and delete synchronization. The "presence" of the interface does not mean that the real-time and governance requirements are met. |
| What is the typical implementation complexity? | Lightweight ranges can be imported and launched with standard templates first; once multi-entity, historical data, complex permissions, bi-directional integration, or statutory calculations are involved, design, cleaning, UAT, parallel operation, training, and post-launch support phases should be set up. |
| What is the minimum safety due diligence question? | Request the latest audit/certification, DPA, subcontractor list, data location, encryption, backup and recovery, RTO/RPO, SSO/SCIM, logs, deletion export mechanism, AI training policy and event notification terms. |
| Can the customer case directly prove the effect? | Thousands of companies have officially joined/used and client use descriptions have been made public; long-term large-scale cases and independent validation are still limited owing to the newer products. The case can only prove a path of feasibility and cannot be a substitute for interviews with clients on the same scale, in the same area, with the modular POC. |
| What is the recommended POC? | Select a real sales team to verify email/calendar synchronization, deduplication, opportunity updates, automation, reporting, and export for 2—4 consecutive weeks; record weekly manual maintenance time, missed follow-up rate, and AI costs. |
| When is it not recommended? | If critical requirements fall outside its boundaries, contract-level safety/compliance evidence cannot be provided, migration and exit scenarios are unclear, or three-year TCO is out of control with real usage, it is not advisable to procure solely because of the interface or AI demo. |
